lines.t: Because you do not have all the answers
Because you do not fully understand
For the Lord your God is truth
Even as I am the truth
For all knowledge resides within the Father
Father, even as I am in the Father, and He is in me, thus I am also the answer.
Sir, my son, trust in me, and you shall be set free.
For it is the humble, penitent man who shall see God.
Behold, He shall look upon my face as I restore Him in my image.
For I am the image of the invisible God
The perfect reflection of the Father
The face of the majesty from on high
Therefore open your heart to me
And I shall create you anew
